You'll have to be present at the competition area at least 10 minutes before the start of your event. 2. All the necessary information is given the Tabs, please have a look. 3. Join [CubistBD](https://www.facebook.com/groups/cubingbangladesh/) to get updates. 4. Follow [Sppedcubing Bangladesh] (https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingBD) to know about comps in Bangladesh. 5. You'll need to show your entry pass in the gate in order to get in.
